feeds.title: Club-K
feeds.description: CLUB-K.net is an Angolan information portal. Our mission is to inform the public about news and information missing from state news channels.

feeds.title: OPaís
feeds.description: OPaís is a generalist and daily Angolan newspaper. Find articles on politics, society, economy, health and wellness, opinion, culture, and more.

feeds.title: Correio da Kianda
feeds.description: Correio da Kianda is a general information portal that aims to provide a wide coverage of the most important and significant national and international events, in all areas of interest.

feeds.title: Notícias de Angola
feeds.description: General information portal on Angola since 2016. Find news on politics, culture, sport, health, economy, beauty, fashion, and more.

feeds.title: Folha 8
feeds.description: Folha 8 is an Angolan newspaper. Find articles on politics, society, economy, culture, and more.

feeds.title: Portal de Angola
feeds.description: We are a portal for information and dissemination of Angola and its Diaspora in the Portuguese-speaking world, which aims to be a reference for all Angolans. The portal provides several thematic channels of information, culture and business, offering a wide range of content of general interest.

feeds.title: Nova Gazeta
feeds.description: News covering society, politics, economy, sport, culture, and more.

feeds.title: Hold On Angola
feeds.description: 'Hold On Angola' is an Angolan news platform covering politics, society, economy, opinion, and more. Recent articles discuss issues like a Supreme Court verdict on currency counterfeiting, the potential cargo movement at Lobito Port, opposition questioning government actions post-public service strike, mobilization of Angolan youth in Europe, and a former governor's conviction for embezzlement.

feeds.title: Valor Económico
feeds.description: Information and analysis of relevant issues that directly or indirectly affect the Angolan and international economy.
